A1.justification: Both complete, readable 23-page PDFs describe S3OD. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison cover the main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-I without material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark, generalization, and ablation experiments in Section 5, plus dataset-quality, efficiency, and decoder analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experimental results in Section 5 and the appendices, including quantitative evaluations of S3ODNet and its synthetic dataset.

M1.justification: Sections 3-4 retain the same DINO-v3/DPT multi-mask architecture, training losses, multimodal diffusion pipeline, iterative sampling, and quality filtering.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage is unchanged: S3OD and the retained real SOD/DIS datasets, together with COD10K, CAMO, and NC4K transfer evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding experiments, including InSPyReNet, BiRefNet, MVANet, MaskFactory, DatasetDM, and the additional appendix baselines.

E3.justification: Both versions specify identical training and evaluation settings, dataset splits, sample sizes, metrics, fine-tuning procedures, and oracle best-mask evaluation.

E4.justification: The generation, modality, architecture, and prompting ablations in Tables 7-10 are unchanged, as are the appendix feature visualizations, domain-gap analysis, qualitative comparisons, and decoder-loss ablation.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. No repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains overall DIS Fm of 0.881 and MAE of 0.039 for S3ODNet trained on S3OD; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, loss formulas, concept-attention expression, category-weight update, and multiple-hypothesis reasoning in Appendix G are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims concerning synthetic-data scale, cross-dataset generalization, ambiguity handling, and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of feature complementarity, benchmark saturation, domain gap, and branch collapse are unchanged. Appendix H retains the same limitations concerning generated artifacts, evaluation on real annotations, and computational cost.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures, prompting instructions, and the project access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The VGGHeads reference title changes, but its authors, year, and arXiv identifier 2407.18245 remain the same. This is a bibliographic metadata update; cited-work membership and research positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp is updated, and the VGGHeads reference title changes from 'A large-scale synthetic dataset for 3d human heads' to '3d multi head alignment with a large-scale synthetic dataset.' All other extracted text and section organization are identical.

P2.justification: Rendered comparison confirms unchanged figures, tables, captions, and layout throughout. Visual differences are confined to the version/date stamp and reference-title text, without structural reflow.

improvement.justification: v3 changes only the version/date stamp and one bibliographic title. The scientific content, supporting evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and presentation structure remain identical, including the appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
